title: Adam Schefter throws cold water on latest A.J. Brown rumor as potential Patriots trade looms

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Adam Schefter throws cold water on latest A.J. Brown rumor as potential Patriots trade looms
sources.description: ESPN NFL insider Adam Schefter said he's waiting on a trade that will send Eagles receiver A.J. Brown to the Patriots regardless of other teams potentially entering the mix.
